After dying in a modern world, a staunch atheist who denied the existence of any higher power is reincarnated by a capricious deity into the body of an innocent, sweet young girl. Denied a peaceful afterlife, he must fight in a brutal magical war on the front lines of a magical empire. Driven by sheer spite and a burning desire to outsmart the entity he dubs "Being X," he vows to rise through the military ranks and wage ultimate war against God himself.

As a deadly mage on the front lines, he seeks to outsmart the very God who forced him into this absurd existence.
